title: Fine-Tuning Next-Scale Visual Autoregressive Models with Group Relative Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2505.23331v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fine-tuning pre-trained generative models with Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as an effective approach for aligning outputs more closely with nuanced human preferences. In this paper, we investigate the application of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to fine-tune next-scale visual autoregressive (VAR) models. Our empirical results demonstrate that this approach enables alignment to intricate reward signals derived from aesthetic predictors and CLIP embeddings, significantly enhancing image quality and enabling precise control over the generation style. Interestingly, by leveraging CLIP, our method can help VAR models generalize beyond their initial ImageNet distribution: through RL-driven exploration, these models can generate images aligned with prompts referencing image styles that were absent during pre-training. translated_title: 基于群体相对策略优化的下一尺度视觉自回归模型微调
translated_abstract: 使用强化学习（RL）对预训练生成模型进行微调已成为使输出更贴近细致人类偏好的一种有效方法。本文研究了将群体相对策略优化（GRPO）应用于微调下一尺度视觉自回归（VAR）模型。我们的实证结果表明，该方法能够对齐来自美学预测器和CLIP嵌入的复杂奖励信号，显著提升图像质量，并实现对生成风格的精确控制。有趣的是，通过利用CLIP，我们的方法可以帮助VAR模型泛化到其初始ImageNet分布之外：通过强化学习驱动的探索，这些模型能够生成与提示词相匹配的图像，其中涉及的图像风格在预训练阶段并未出现。总之，我们证明了基于强化学习的微调对VAR模型而言既高效又有效。
tldr: 本文将群体相对策略优化（GRPO）应用于下一尺度视觉自回归（VAR）模型的强化学习微调，通过对齐美学与CLIP奖励信号显著提升图像质量与风格控制能力，并使模型能够泛化生成预训练阶段未见过的图像风格。
en_tdlr: This paper applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to fine-tune next-scale visual autoregressive (VAR) models, aligning them with aesthetic and CLIP-based reward signals to significantly enhance image quality and style control, while enabling generalization to image styles unseen during pre-training.
